title: Collections (Part 1) - Strings, vectors, and maps
learning_objectives: Distinguish owned `String` values from borrowed string slices.
Create, update, access, and iterate over a `Vec`.
Store and retrieve keyed values with a `HashMap`.
Choose a collection that matches a small data-management task.
explanation: Growable collections keep related values together. A `String` owns UTF-8 text, a `Vec<T>` owns an ordered sequence of values, and a `HashMap<K, V>` associates keys with values. Collection operations often transfer ownership, so choosing whether to borrow or move a value is part of using these types.

examples.title: Own growable text
Append and read values in a vector
Index values by a key

compiler_error_examples: error[E0502]: cannot borrow `scores` as mutable because it is also borrowed as immutable
completion_criteria: Exercise tests cover multiple records, repeated keys, and a missing key
Learner can explain the distinct roles of `String`, `Vec`, and `HashMap`
Learner can describe why lookup returns an optional value
